run_extract_mel_spectrograms: run the CLI to extract log-mel spectrogram features from audio samples and pack them into a ZIP archive
run_extract_pitch_energy: run the CLI with --add-fastspeech-targets to extract pitch and energy features alongside mel spectrograms
run_generate_feature_manifest: run the CLI to generate TSV manifest files with audio paths, text, speaker, and frame count per split
run_generate_vocab_and_config: run the CLI to generate a vocab file or SentencePiece model and a config YAML for training
run_filter_by_snr_cer: run the CLI with --snr-threshold and --cer-threshold to filter out low-quality audio samples from the manifest
